sourceDisposition: Two-file delta only. Fixed progress schema limits64 records; captures own data properties before awaited write, rejects accessors/unknown fields/unsafe counters, and emits only fixed enums/numbers/source hash with wall and monotonic timestamps. No event fields or raw errors enter telemetry.

Actual Chromium measure function forwards through page.exposeFunction to parent validated projection. CLI synchronously writes each entire JSON line to inherited supervisor log descriptor, handling partial writes. Prior completed lines survive benchmark SIGKILL; no user-space stdout buffering dependency.

Completed seed metrics and every validated warm query count/duration persist before final report. Query timing interval and five-sample p95, equality, bounded reads, process RSS and acceptance thresholds unchanged; progress occurs outside timed query interval. It adds between-query scheduling overhead, not identical wall-time execution.
Telemetry failure fails measurement; variant and browser/listener cleanup still attempted. Successful cleanup status is separate from experiment success and cannot manufacture a partial pass.

Real tiny LMDB tests verify telemetry against actual measurement, late failure retains metrics and cleanup, and caller mutation/accessor/unsafe values/cap fail closed. No Chromium/large benchmark performed by reviewer.
rerunConditions: One fresh explicit50k Chromium run only after parent releases heavy slot, using mandatory existing owned-tree supervisor540s/4GiB and exact source/helper/run binding. Preserve original interrupted failure.

Run on awake foreground host with scoped existing sleep-prevention operation; retain power-event/elapsed evidence and invalidate any interrupted measurement rather than subtracting sleep time or extending deadline.
Require complete final result, all query/correctness/per-process RSS assertions and successful owned-tree cleanup. Progress alone is not qualification.
limitations: Progress is kernel-written to supervisor log, not fsync-backed power-loss durability.

Before variant-start, preparation/bundling/launch/page-ready remain grouped; within variant-start to seed-complete there is no per-chunk seed progress. These do not block this changed diagnostic run but limit future stall localization.
Existing supervisor has no per-sample timestamp/gap heartbeat; wall/monotonic progress and independent host power logs remain necessary for interruption assessment.
No cold PXE synchronization/real encrypted chain ingestion or fullproduct capacity acceptance.
